structure.description: A container for a single value.

value.description: A value to indicate success/failure with an optional error message.
A container of bytes (8-bits per element).
A string representing a filesystem location.
Describes an action on the filesystem.

node.name: Current Step
node.description: Get the current step of the process execution.

node.name: Conditional
node.description: Forwards either the input 'true' or the input 'false' to the output depending the condition.

node.name: Delay
node.description: Forwards the input to the output after sleeping for a specified number of seconds.

node.name: Demux
node.description: Forwards the input to one of the outputs.

node.name: Replace
node.description: Ignores the 'in' input and forwards the 'replacement' input to 'out'.

node.name: If/Else
node.description: Forward input to one of the two outputs.
Forwards the input 'in' to either the output 'true' or 'false' depending on 'condition'.

node.name: Join
node.description: Join multiple flow paths into one
Takes the first input which is neither 'invalid' nor 'ignore' and forwards it to the output.

node.name: Mux
node.description: Selects one input to be forwarded to the output. Discards all other inputs.

node.name: Terminate
node.description: Terminates the process execution if presented with "true" on the input or an error-code holding an error.

node.name: Set
node.description: Stores data in volatile storage. Returns previously stored data (if any).

node.name: Get
node.description: Retrieves data previously stored in volatile storage.

node.name: Is Invalid
node.description: Checks if a provided input is an invalid structure.

node.name: Is Droplet
node.description: Checks if a provided input is a droplet structure.

node.name: Is List
node.description: Checks if a provided input is a list structure.

node.name: Is Table
node.description: Checks if a provided input is a table structure.

node.name: Is Map
node.description: Checks if a provided input is a map structure.

group.name: List

node.name: Accumulate
node.description: Creates a list and adds each received input droplet to the list.

node.name: Append
node.description: Append one or more droplets to a list.

node.name: Are Same Size
node.description: Checks if the size of two or more input lists are the same (equal).

node.name: Fill
node.description: Makes a list of the specified size where each element is the same value.

node.name: From Droplets
node.description: Combines two or more droplets into a list.

node.name: Get Droplet
node.description: Get a droplet from a list by index.

node.name: Get First
node.description: Gets the first element of a list. If the list is empty, invalid is returned.

node.name: Get Last
node.description: Gets the last element of a list. If the list is empty, invalid is returned.

node.name: Remove Consecutive Duplicates
node.description: Eliminates all except the first element from every consecutive group of equivalent elements.

node.name: Remove (if)
node.description: Removes all elements which equal a specified value.

node.name: Remove (Index)
node.description: Removes a specific element by index.

node.name: Repeat
node.description: Returns a list containing 'count' copies of the 'in' input list.

node.name: Sample
node.description: Get a sample of the list
Get 'count' randomly chosen elements from the input list.

node.name: Shuffle
node.description: Reorders the elements in a list such that each possible permutation of those elements has an equal probability of appearance.

node.name: To Droplets
node.description: Extracts individual droplets form a list.

group.node:
Contains
Contains key Checks if a particular key is present in the map.

node.name: Insert Or Assign
node.description: Inserts a value with a given key or assigns it if the key already exists.

node.name: Get
node.description: Get the value associated with a given key from a map.

group.node:
Size instruments::ruler Map size Get the number of elements in a map.
>

node.name: To Table
node.description: Creates a table from a map. The resulting table will have two columns: key and value.

node.name: Accumulate Columns
node.description: Accumulate lists as columns into a table
Creates a table and adds each received list as a column to the table.

node.name: Accumulate Rows
node.description: Accumulate lists as rows into a table
Creates a table and adds each received list as a row to the table.

node.name: Append Row
node.description: Append a row to a table.

node.name: Append Column
node.description: Append a colum to a table.

node.name: Row Count
node.description: Get the numbers of rows of a table.

node.name: Column Count
node.description: Get the numbers of columns of a table.

node.name: Create Table
node.description: Create a table of a specific size where each cell is pre-filled with a specific value.

node.name: Filter By Column
node.description: Removes any rows where a cell value does not equal a provided value.

node.name: From Columns
node.description: Combines one or more lists into a table (column-wise).

parameter.name: Output if empty
parameter.description: Whether to output a table if it is empty.

node.name: From Rows
node.description: Combines one or more lists into a table (row-wise).

parameter.name: Output if empty
parameter.description: Whether to output a table if it is empty.

node.name: For-Each Row
node.description: Returns each row of the table, one after another.

node.name: Get Cell
node.description: Get a specific cell of a table.

node.name: Get Column
node.description: Get a specific column of a table.

node.name: Get Columns
node.description: Constructs a table containing only specified columns.

node.name: Get Horizontal Header
node.description: Get the horizontal header from a table (if any).

node.name: Get Row
node.description: Get a specific row of a table.

node.name: Row By Cell Value
node.description: Get the first row from a table where a cell matches a specific value.

node.name: Has Horizontal Header
node.description: Checks whether a provided table has a horizontal header.

node.name: Remove Column (Index)
node.description: Remove an existing table column by index.

node.name: Remove Row (if)
node.description: Remove any row where a column value equals a specified value.

node.name: Remove Row (Index)
node.description: Remove an existing table row by index.

node.name: Sort (by column)
node.description: Sorts a table by a column (in ascending order).

node.name: Transpose
node.description: Flips the table around (rows become columns, columns become rows).

node.name: Pretty Print
node.description: Produces a pretty string representation of the table.

node.name: Set Column
node.description: Sets (modifies) the contents of an existing column.

node.name: Set Horizontal Header
node.description: Sets the horizontal header of a table.

node.name: Set Row
node.description: Sets (modifies) the contents of an existing row.

node.name: Replace If
node.description: Replaces any value on input 'in' with the value 'replacement' if it equals 'equal to'.

node.name: Check Error
node.description: Checks whether an error code holds an error and retrieves the error message.

node.name: Make Error
node.description: Creates an error with a given message if 'condition' is true. Returns a non-error otherwise.

node.name: Forward First Error
node.description: Forward the first error-code holding an error
Loops sequentially through all the inputs and forwards the first error-code holding an error to the output. If no error-code holding an error was encountered, returns an empty error-code (success).

node.name: To Hex String
node.description: Convert an integer value to a hexadecimal string value.

node.name: To Real
node.description: Convert values to real values. Returns invalid value if conversion is not possible.

node.name: Epsilon
node.description: Returns the difference between 1.0 and the next representable value of the real (floating-point) type
